Receipts/DuplicateIntKeySilentlyDroppedTests.cs: edge-case test passes on head (1 tests): no defect shown; refutes 1 lens claim(s): logic-edge-1

refutes.claim: Duplicate integer keys are now silently accepted. For a type with `[Key(0)] public int KeptMember` and `[Key(0)] public int DroppedCandidate`, the new `ContainsKey` guard throws away the second member. The generator then emits a formatter that never serializes it, and no analyzer or generator diagnostic is reported. Base threw (the generator crashed, so the problem was visible); the dynamic resolver rejects duplicate keys at run time. On head, data is silently lost even when `SuppressSourceGeneration` is unset, which breaks the requirement that behaviour without the flag does not change. The derived-key `continue` added above already handles the case the requirement is about, so this guard only hides real duplicates.
